description: Correct name, date of birth, address, or marital status on CNIC.
required_documents: Biometric verification of a blood relative (for name/DOB change)
Matriculation Certificate or Birth Certificate (for DOB)
application_mode: Online via Pak Identity App OR In-person at NADRA Center
rejection_guidance: If rejected due to fingerprint mismatch, you must visit a physical NADRA Mega Center for manual biometrics override. Online system cannot bypass faded fingerprints.
steps: Download Pak Identity App or visit nearest NADRA center.
Submit required proof document (e.g., Matric certificate).
Receive corrected CNIC in 7-10 working days.
